summary: Iteration 5 — Reminders + Refer-a-Friend feature testing. Extended pytest suite from 20 to 31 tests, ALL PASSED (31/31, 100%). New backend coverage: (1) register returns unique referral_code (GNG-prefixed) + credit_balance=0 + referred_by_code null when no ref, (2) admin seeded with referral_code, (3) register with valid referral_code links user + populates referrals list on referrer, (4) unknown referral silently ignored, (5) /referrals/me requires auth, returns friend_discount_pct=15 + referrer_credit=150, (6) /bookings/quote returns full pricing breakdown; first-booking referred user gets 15% off, drops to 0% after first booking, (7) /bookings for referred user's first booking persists list_price + discount_pct=15 + credit_used + reminder_status, (8) End-to-end referral reward: seeded Bob with 500 credit, first booking of list 200 → credit_used=170, price=0, payment_status=paid, Bob balance decremented to 330, Alice awarded +150; second paid booking does NOT re-credit Alice; Alice's /referrals/me shows Bob rewarded=true, (9) admin reminders 403 for non-admin, (10) POST /admin/reminders/run queues reminders for date=tomorrow bookings, idempotent (2nd run does not duplicate), booking reminder_status flips to 'queued'. Frontend Playwright verified: (a) ?ref=CODE URL auto-opens register modal, prefills auth-referral-input with the code, shows green referral-banner, (b) /refer page shows refer-page + refer-code-card + refer-code-value + refer-copy-button + refer-share-button + refer-balance + refer-link, (c) Booking modal for referred first-time signed-in user displays booking-perks with perk-discount chip '15% first-booking discount applied' and Total drops from ₹150 to ₹127.5 (15% off ₹150), (d) /my-bookings shows my-bookings-referral summary card ('Credit balance ₹0') and my-bookings-refer-link ('Refer & earn ₹150') CTA, (e) /admin shows admin-reminders-section + admin-run-reminders button; click triggers POST /admin/reminders/run, message 'Queued 0 reminders.' (0 new because idempotent — reminders already exist for prior tomorrow bookings) and 2 reminder-row-<id> entries render correctly with SMS · QUEUED badges. No regressions in prior 20 auth/booking/payments tests.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py file is now ~780 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting: (a) auth routes + helpers to auth.py, (b) referrals+quote+reminders to referrals.py, (c) razorpay routes to payments.py. Current single-file layout is still OK for MVP.

_maybe_award_referrer relies on user doc field 'first_paid_reward_at' to be missing — an eventual re-run/replay of a webhook won't double-credit thanks to the compound filter, good. But if two webhooks arrive concurrently there is a small race: consider a single find_one_and_update with $setOnInsert semantics or use the update result's matched_count to gate the $inc on referrer.

Reminder scheduler always runs every 60 minutes hardcoded — no way to configure. Also scheduler.start() at startup will silently swallow errors during job. Consider logging exceptions inside _run_reminder_job.
/api/bookings/quote does not clamp price to a sane max — a caller could send price=1e12. Not exploitable but validate max in QuoteIn (Field(le=100000)).
CORS: dead branch reading CORS_ORIGINS still present (server.py L710-712) — same feedback from iteration 4, still not addressed.

referral_code field on user doc: register generates it via secrets.token_hex(3) → collision retry OK; but generate_referral_code() has no upper cap on retries — theoretical infinite loop if the index is exhausted. Fine for MVP scale.
_run_reminder_job resends 'pending' or missing reminder_status only; if a booking is later moved to a different date the old queued reminder is not invalidated — future enhancement.
Admin dashboard fetches admin/reminders every mount with limit 200 and no pagination — flag for scale.
Register endpoint uses body.referral_code with max_length=20; token is uppercased before lookup — good.
test_credentials: admin@gngwar.com / Admin@GngWar2026 (seeded, has referral_code). TEST_alice_<uuid>@test.com + TEST_bob_<uuid>@test.com per run.
seed_data_creation: Each run creates TEST_ prefixed Alice + Bob users; a Bob referred booking; reminder log entries for tomorrow's dated bookings. No cleanup performed (all TEST_ prefixed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New testids verified: auth-referral-input, referral-banner, refer-page, refer-code-card, refer-code-value, refer-copy-button, refer-share-button, refer-balance, refer-link, booking-perks, perk-discount (perk-credit shown only when credit_balance>0 — not tested via UI but backend covers this via test_credit_covers_full_price...), my-bookings-referral, my-bookings-refer-link, admin-reminders-section, admin-run-reminders, admin-reminder-msg, reminder-row-<id>. Backend: _maybe_award_referrer only triggers via (a) full-credit-covers-price path in POST /bookings OR (b) POST /payments/razorpay/verify (Razorpay disabled). Both branches tested — the credit-cover path is E2E-verified via seeded test. Reminder job is idempotent (booking reminder_status gate). Scheduler runs hourly automatically.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing tests. The one 'Queued 0 reminders' observation in the admin UI is EXPECTED: prior test iterations already queued reminders for the tomorrow-dated bookings created in earlier runs, so re-running the job correctly returns 0 new queued (idempotency guarantee).
